text: The case list of the cycle, the COLLINS score data product, the DEBTSALE rule package and the case-move answer are consumed on their owners' published contracts, never as tables or views, and their operation names stay placeholders until the owners publish them.
why: Only rwb-source-data holds SELECT on the 30 recovery.v_ace_* views and only rwb-case writes recovery_case, while rwb-decision governs the rule rows. TSD S6 T5.2 names the published interfaces only as module interfaces and publishes no operation name for these four reads, so no name may be invented. The plan's C row for the slice is empty, so the rows are C dependencies in fact and not in the metadata.
